stories.title: Largest Private Conservation Project in the US Hits Major Milestone as Free-Roaming Bison Pass 1,000
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: Out on the Great Plains, a huge conservation ranch just hit a wonderful milestone: its free-roaming bison herd has grown past 1,000 animals. These bison live much like their wild ancestors did, grazing freely across vast grasslands that are being restored as a result. It's the largest private conservation project of its kind in the country, and this growing herd shows the land and wildlife are genuinely thriving together. A nice reminder that patient, long-term work on the land really can pay off.
stories.why_good: A real, measured population milestone (not a projection) showing a successful, ongoing conservation effort restoring American grasslands and wildlife.
